fusions.name: Chest-Beat Gale
fusions.desc: Beats both wings against your chest and drives the air out in a cone 4.5 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit, and each has a 40% chance to leave the target [Stunned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: The Long Dunk
fusions.desc: Grabs a target and holds it under, dealing 14 damage and stunning it for 1.4 seconds. It comes up [Soaked] for 8 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Feigned Boredom
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and restores 8 health. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Patience Then Knuckles
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
